summary: Read music scores with setlists and half-page turns.
page_description: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

job: Read music scores with setlists and half-page turns.
offline: Everything works without the network; scores arrive from your computer.
